agent_says.description: Untrusted requester annotation, shown separately from trusted facts.

facts.description: Daemon-computed facts, present only on full approval views.

reason_codes.description: Why it is needed, for example `handoff.interrupted`, `session.first_use`, `retry.exhausted`.

requested_by.description: Authenticated requesting credential, independent of display text.

approval.description: Public approval entity; private facts and requester annotations never enter events.

oneOf.description: Withdrawn because the job was canceled.

Display data of an approval. Everything here is computed by the daemon except `title` and
`requested_by`, which are untrusted text.

requested_by.description: The requesting client's name (untrusted, at most 128 characters).

title.description: File name or plan title (untrusted, at most 255 characters).

extension_id.description: Extension id (informational; the attested id is authoritative).

incognito.description: The download came from a private window.

offer_key.description: `<browser>:<download id>:<start time>`, the deduplication key of a handoff offer.

profile_id.description: Which browser profile (and therefore which cookie jar): 32 lowercase hex characters.

BrowserName.description: Browser family reported by the extension.

instance_id.description: 32 lowercase hex characters, new on every start.

grant_id.description: The grant the decision created, if any.

DecisionOutcome.description: The decision a human (or the system, for `expire` and `cancel`) took.

ErrorClass.description:
Coarse, stable failure class (00 section 9.2). The first nine drive job retry policy
(01 section 8); the rest classify protocol-level errors.

oneOf.description: The server asked us to slow down.
The session or credential was rejected.
The signed or one-shot URL no longer works.
The server refuses this client but may accept the user's browser.
Bytes or metadata contradict each other or an expectation.
A rule or a human said no.
The named entity does not exist.
The request conflicts with current state.
The caller is not an authorised peer.
The peer lacks the capability or version.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The error envelope every process boundary uses (00 section 9.1).

class.description: Coarse class; drives retry and presentation.

details.description: Code-specific structured data, at most 8 KiB serialised. No secrets.

message.description: English diagnostic, at most 1024 characters. Never parsed. No secrets.

retryable.description:
True iff repeating the same request, possibly after the delay or refresh the class
implies, may succeed without human action.

job_id.description: Identifier with the prefix `job_` followed by a 26 character ULID.

run_id.description: Identifier with the prefix `run_` followed by a 26 character ULID.

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with exactly three fractional digits and the Z designator.

FilenameSource.description: Where the resolved file name came from.

oneOf.description: The last path segment of the URL.
The hint in the job spec or the browser offer.
A default derived from the media type.
One job and all its retries; hard maximum 24 hours.
One origin and one run for 7 days, renewable by a human.
Block-list entry: no expiry until a human removes it.

GrantScopeHint.description: The scopes a request may suggest (never `never`).

oneOf.description: One origin and one run for 7 days.

grant_id.description: The effective grant the job currently relies on.

quarantined.description: Only ever true when `state` is `completed`; immutable afterwards.

duration_ms.description: Wall time from creation to completion.

session_origin.description: Origin whose session the job needs.

JobResult.description: The outcome of a completed job (01 section 3.9).

path.description: Absolute final path on the daemon's host.

attempt.description: Which retry this is (1 for the first).

restart_from_zero.description: The restart invalidated every committed range.

JobSpec.description:
The immutable request that created a job. Only `priority` may change afterwards.

Fields with a default are `Option` here so a client request round-trips unchanged; the daemon
calls [`JobSpec::apply_defaults`] before storing the job, and the accessors below read the
effective value.

dest_dir.description: Destination directory; must resolve inside a configured write root.

expected_sha256.description: A mismatch is an `integrity` failure after at most one restart.

expected_size.description: Likewise for the size in bytes.

filename.description: A file name hint. The final name comes from `Content-Disposition` first.

grant_scope_hint.description: A suggestion shown on the approval; the human chooses.

hint_url.description: Last known resolved (often signed) URL; tried first, `url` is the fallback.

labels.description: Free-form tags from the caller. Untrusted data.

max_connections.description: Upper bound on connections, 1 to 32. Default 8.

overwrite.description: What to do if the final path exists. Default `rename`.

priority.description: Default `normal` (`high` for browser handoffs). The only mutable field.

referrer.description: Sent as `Referer` only for same-origin or allow-listed requests; always kept for provenance.

session_origin.description: The origin whose session the job needs; its presence makes the job require an effective grant.

url.description: The stable address of the resource (http or https, at most 8192 bytes).

oneOf.description: Accepted, waiting for a scheduler slot.
Probe and resume validation in flight; no payload bytes are committed in this state.
Blocked on a human decision (an Approval is pending).
Blocked on session material, a fresh URL or the in-browser proxy; no human needed.
Payload bytes are being fetched and committed.
Held by an explicit pause; resumes only on request.
Waiting for `next_attempt_at` after a retryable error.
All bytes committed; hashing and content checks.
Non-interruptible: OS marks, fsync, atomic rename, completion commit.
File is at its final path and verified. May carry `quarantined = true`.
Stopped with an error. Only a manual retry leaves this state.
Stopped by request; partial data deleted.

transition.description: The transition id from the table.

JobSummary.description: Compact projection of [`Job`] for list views and the extension popup.

filename.description: The resolved or hinted name. Untrusted text.

rate_ewma.description: Current transfer rate in bytes per second.

state_seq.description: Durable event that placed the job in its current state, filled by the daemon.

status.description: HTTP status, when the signal was a status.

expected_sha256_match.description: Whether `expected_sha256` matched; `null` when none was given.

expected_size_match.description: Whether `expected_size` matched; `null` when none was given.

mime_match.description: Whether the two agree, when both are known.

oneOf.description: Bytes will be downloaded with it.

Overwrite.description: What to do if the final path exists (`spec.overwrite`).

oneOf.description: Move the old file to the application trash first (03 section 8.1).

Priority.description: Scheduling weight class (01 section 3.2). Weighted fair queueing uses 1, 2 and 4.

oneOf.description: Weight 4. The default for browser handoffs.
A plain `GET`, when `HEAD` and ranged `GET` are both refused.

ProbeResult.description: The result of one probe (each entry into `probing`, 01 section 3.5).

content_encoding.description: As received; anything but identity on an identity-only request is an error.

final_url_redacted.description: The final URL after redirects, redacted.

interstitial_suspected.description: The response looked like an HTML wall instead of the expected file.

requires_session.description: The origin refused an unauthenticated request in a way a session may fix.

status.description: The status of the final response.

total_bytes.description: From `Content-Range`, else `Content-Length` of an unranged `200`, else `null`.

Progress.description:
Committed-byte progress (01 section 3.7). Always reflects committed bytes, so what an agent reads
survives a crash.

bytes_done.description: Committed bytes (during `verifying`, bytes hashed so far).

eta_s.description: Seconds remaining, `null` when either input is unknown or the rate is zero.

last_error_class.description: Class of the latest error, kept after recovery so agents can see flakiness.

rate_ewma.description: Bytes per second, EWMA with alpha 0.2 over 1 s samples; zero outside `downloading`/`verifying`.

QuarantineReason.description: Why a completed file carries Zeus's own stronger flag (01 section 11.3).

oneOf.description: Executable, script, installer, `.jar`, `.lnk`, `.scr`, `.dll` or a macro-enabled document.
Detected type contradicts the declared one across a safety boundary.
HTML or script content under a non-HTML name or type.
An archive exceeds the safety limits.
The optional antivirus hook reported the file as not clean.
The origin is not trusted and `quarantine_untrusted` is enabled.
Retrieved with a session lease and `quarantine_session_files` is enabled.

RangeSupport.description: What the probe learned about range support (01 section 3.5).

oneOf.description: A `206` with a correct `Content-Range` was observed in this job.
Not known yet. `Accept-Ranges` is advisory and never sufficient.

audit_chain_ok.description: Whether the audit chain tail verified.

jobs_failed.description: Jobs failed as a crash loop.

RefreshNeed.description: What `job.state_changed` and friends say about why session material is needed.

oneOf.description: The lease time to live ended.

ResolvedFilename.description: A resolved file name and its provenance.

value.description: The name, 1 to 255 characters. Untrusted text; always sanitised before use as a path.

RetryState.description: Counters that make retry policy restart-safe (01 section 3.8).

auth_refreshes.description: Session or URL refreshes since the last reset (budget 3).

consecutive_failures.description: Failures since the last progress reset.

integrity_restarts.description: Restarts from zero caused by a hash or size mismatch (budget 1).

last_progress_at.description: When `bytes_done` last grew by at least the reset threshold.

recovery_count.description: Daemon-restart recoveries since the last committed progress (crash-loop limit 3).

resource_restarts.description: Restarts caused by the resource changing upstream (budget 2).

oneOf.description: A never grant blocks the origin.

Segment.description: A planned work unit over the half-open interval `[start, end)`.

oneOf.description: Its retry budget is spent; job-level classification applies.

origin.description: The one origin the grant covers.

renewable.description: Whether a human can renew it.

uses.description: Number of leases issued under it.

client_id.description: The authenticated client, at most 128 characters. Untrusted text when shown to a model.

kind.description: The kind; determines default priority and which approvals apply.

run_id.description: The workflow run (for `workflow` and `agent` jobs started by a run).

oneOf.description: A failed or user-forwarded browser download through the extension.
An MCP tool call or an A2A task.
A human using the CLI or TUI.
The workflow runner executing an approved plan.

oneOf.description: Reserved for the creation event payload.
Pause, resume, cancel or retry by a client.
Session material, a fresh URL or the proxy is needed.
A client asked to retry now.

The file reached its final path.
